The '''Financial District''' was home to many wealthy businesses and businessmen on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It bordered the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], intersected with, and in many places coincided with, the [[Business district (Coruscant)|business district]], and encompassed an area of roughly 30 square [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] (12 square miles).
